atlas.title: Azeroth Survivors — Build Atlas: All-Class + Field Research
atlas.game_version: game binary from prior v0.130.0 research

verified: 104 registered class abilities from user-supplied WebAssembly binary
82 talent milestone/capstone text effects from binary
9 exact 51-point talent allocations from archived edited save ZIP
Rarity roll weights 60,25m,10m²,4m³,m⁴ with m=1+luck+min(level·0.01,0.30) (amulet branch +0.5)
Rings and trinkets lock once both slots are filled; amulets can be replaced (observed in-game)
User tested +100% Hunter PvP controlled-target damage on slowed bosses; Concussive Shot +150% is a separate listed bonus.
All nine classes have a class-specific Inferno AoE amulet with a shared Legendary effect pattern, as user confirmed.
Inferno kill explosions damage bosses, and can chain off kills caused by earlier explosions, observed by user.
Druid Hurricane Inferno damage meter and Mage/Hunter DPS snapshots were captured during live gameplay.
proxy: Relative spell score and one-slot alternatives use qualitative role tags and synergy, not original combat engine
Jewelry and race recommendations are conditional starting points, not measured optimal sets
Historical combat gauntlet used hunter gear and unrealistically generous Paladin shields; its clear rates were not carried over
Talent plan is the 51-rank saved baseline; alternatives have not been fully optimized or proven valid against talent-tree prerequisites
The cooldown floor of 0.3 seconds is a player tooltip observation, not a confirmed game-engine universal cap.
Fire Lord vs Malice, and Hunter Eye vs Inferno, lack isolated controlled DPS comparisons. Recommendations are conditional.
Class-specific Inferno exact AoE names for the eight non-Druid classes are not verified by supplied item tooltips.
The v5.14 advisor uses effect-aware numeric heuristics; rankings are not true DPS simulations.
source_notes.study: 9 class-verified spell rosters (104 abilities), one-slot swaps under 3 pressure settings, 40-item jewelry sensitivity per class/scenario (1,080 comparisons), 607,500 exact-formula rarity samples, and 459 allocated talent ranks from saved 51-point plans. Combat effect sizes are qualitative proxies, not recovered game physics. New field evidence: Fire Mage run recorder, Hunter PvP boss slow test, Hunter Eye ranks 1–4 tooltips/meter, Druid Hurricane Inferno meter, and user-tested Inferno chaining/boss hits.
uncertain: Demonic Empowerment v0.131 mechanic documented; Demonology + Legionlord DPS superiority not tested by user.

talent_effects.effect: Milestone. Every {v}th shot you fire is followed by a free Aimed Shot.
Capstone. You start every run with Aimed Shot; its cooldown is {v}% shorter and a killing blow readies it again, at most every 2 sec.

field_evidence.text: Slowing a boss activates the Hunter PvP 8-piece controlled-target damage bonus. Separate tooltip effect gives Concussive Shot +150% damage; user confirms +100% other damage to controlled targets.
Eye of the Splitting Sky leap hits ALSO apply Concussive Shot slow. This spreads PvP damage amplification to multiple enemies.
At rank 3 Eye and level ~35: Concussive Shot 5.39M (27%) + Eye 2.45M (12%) = 7.84M (39%) total attributed. Not the marginal damage added by Eye.
Ranks 1–4: +1 target each, 2 leap targets each; Concussive bonus +20/+24/+28/+31%, leap damage 30/36/41/46%.
Whether the Concussive +150% and PvP controlled-target +100% bonuses stack on Concussive itself is unknown; do not double count.

Hunter.measured_context: Actual Hunter damage-meter snapshot around level 35 / 9:22 into run, with Eye of the Splitting Sky rank 3, 5★ Hunter PvP armor. Shares are cumulative and affected by other upgrades.

amulet_candidates.name: Eye of the Splitting Sky: Concussive Shot
amulet_candidates.rationale: Concussive Shot extra target(s) and chaining hits apply slow; all slowed enemies can trigger the PvP controlled-target bonus. At rank 3 in one run, Concussive + Eye were 39% of recorded total damage.

Warlock.role: DoTs, spreading afflictions and death explosions

jewelry.ring_notes: 2 rings locked when filled; upgrade same item if offered
jewelry.trinket_notes: 2 trinkets locked when filled; upgrade same item if offered
jewelry.amulet_notes: Directly observed at 87.79M / 46% of cumulative damage in Warlock run 01; a separate 30-second boss meter showed 573.1K / 61%. At observed Rank 4, the card lists Corruption +4 targets, +124% damage, and kills with Corruption explode for 28% of target max HP up to 2 times/sec. Excellent observed performance in this run; no controlled Malice or Curse of Agony amulet comparison yet.

Warlock.caution: Seed of Corruption is a talent capstone, not a selectable spell. Rain of Fire was only 1% overall damage in Warlock run 01 despite several upgrades; it is no longer a default slot. Immolate is a candidate for a controlled replacement test, NOT a proven improvement. Death Coil had low damage but adds healing.

talent_effects.effect: Milestone. Your Shadow Bolts carry the night: each one that lands corrupts its target for {v}% of the bolt over 12 sec, and every tick of Corruption has a 2% chance to fire a free Shadow Bolt, at most twice a second.
Milestone. When an enemy dies with Corruption or Curse of Agony on it, each jumps to the enemy nearest it.
Capstone. You start every run with Corruption, and enemies that die afflicted by your damage-over-time effects burst for {v}% of their maximum health on everything within 6 yd.

field_evidence.text: Final overall damage: Pendant of the Plague 87.79M (46%), Corruption 40.13M (21%), Curse of Agony 20.00M (10%), Seed of Corruption 13.28M (7%). The pendant + these three DoT/proc sources were 84% using rounded on-screen shares; the pendant dominates this setup, not necessarily all encounters.

Rain of Fire only did 2.29M (~1%) despite several invested upgrades, including Rank 6 and area/duration/CDR improvements. Demoted from the six-spell default. The suggested sixth spell Immolate is an UNTESTED replacement; it might provide extra DoT/Seed interactions, but there is no run evidence that it actually outperforms Rain of Fire.

Player-provided 30-second boss damage screenshot showed Pendant of the Plague 573.1K (61% boss damage), Seed of Corruption 67.3K (7%), Shadow Bolt 53.4K (6%). This is not the same capture as the final overall meter; both point to strong pendant performance but cannot be used as controlled DPS comparisons.

field_evidence.tag: CONFIRMED TOOLTIP • Pendant of the Plague
field_evidence.text: Rank 4 Corruption pendant option shown: +4 Corruption targets, +124% Corruption damage, and explosion on enemy death while corrupted for 28% of enemy max HP at most twice/second. Curse of Agony pendant at Rank 3 was offered, but not chosen.

The compact recorder captured 71 choice screens, 64 confirmed mouse selections, and 393 meter images. Some selection OCR is incomplete; the recorder captured only overall damage, not the separate boss/healing panels. Death Coil is only ~1% overall damage but has a healing function, so removing it purely on damage would be unsound. Quantitative heal and trigger counts remain unavailable.

The pre-run qualitative scenario scores and substitution deltas were estimated for the original Rain of Fire route. They were not recalculated from the actual game combat engine and do not validate the new experimental Immolate slot.

Warlock.measured_context: Warlock Run 01, recorded 2026-10-31 23:35 to 2026-11-01 00:10 (local). Final readable OVERALL-damage screenshot at 00:10:01. Shares displayed by the game are rounded; separate boss panel was not automatically recorded.

rules: Incremental card effects are scored by their magnitude: 2% cooldown reduction is not equal to 16%.
Multiple bonuses are considered together (damage, cooldown, additional targets, area, duration).
Jewelry upgrades showing OLD → NEW values use the difference, not the entire displayed total.
High cumulative cooldown reduction receives a conservative discount; a 0.3 s minimum has not been validated.
Unreadable or ambiguous OCR values are scored conservatively instead of treated as enormous bonuses.
Rarity has modest influence once the actual effect value is known.
scoring_update.limits: Effect-aware heuristic, not a complete game-engine DPS optimizer; cooldown floor, proc interactions, current cooldown, and card OCR remain imperfect.

global_findings.label: Warlock Run 01 • Observed gameplay
global_findings.title: Corruption pendant dominates; Rain of Fire demoted
global_findings.details: Final overall screenshot: Pendant of the Plague 87.79M (46%), Corruption 40.13M (21%), Curse of Agony 20.00M (10%), Seed of Corruption 13.28M (7%). Rain of Fire did only 2.29M (1%) despite Rank 6 / several upgrades. A separate boss screenshot recorded pendant at 573.1K (61%). Proposed replacement Immolate is an untested candidate.

global_findings.label: Observed gameplay
global_findings.title: Hunter PvP works on bosses
global_findings.details: Slowing a boss activates the Hunter PvP 8-piece controlled-target damage effect. User reports +100% damage to controlled targets, distinct from +150% Concussive Shot damage. Whether both apply to Concussive Shot simultaneously remains unverified.

global_findings.label: Observed gameplay
global_findings.title: Inferno explosions chain and hit bosses
global_findings.details: Every class has a class-specific Inferno AoE variant. The documented Legendary Druid Hurricane version grants +50% area, +100% duration, +50% damage, plus kill explosions for 30% of maximum HP up to two activations per second. User confirms explosions can hit bosses and chain on kills. The exact cap scope remains unknown.

global_findings.label: Recorded run
global_findings.title: Mage damage is fire-proc concentrated
global_findings.details: In one recorded Fire Mage run: Hot Streak 34%, Pyroclasm 29%, Ignite 14%, Pyroblast 14% of total damage (91% combined). This is a distribution, not proof of any card's marginal contribution.

global_findings.label: Unconfirmed
global_findings.title: 0.3-second cooldown floor
global_findings.details: Hover tooltips appeared to stop at 0.3 s under high CDR. Until gameplay/client mechanics confirm a floor, extra CDR at extreme totals should be downgraded conservatively, not treated as guaranteed zero.

global_findings.label: Advisor v5.14
global_findings.title: Effect-aware drafting across all nine classes
global_findings.details: Ranking now evaluates visible card percentage changes and multi-effect gains rather than flat +8 cooldown/+4 damage/+5 targets. 445 Python mirror checks passed; PowerShell/live-game behavior was not verified by those checks.

field_evidence.text: Research Meter overall: 28.86M cumulative damage and 52.9K average DPS. Leading four demons: Dread Lord 7.55M (26%); Imp 7.16M (25%); Felhunter 5.28M (18%); Succubus 1.56M (5%) — 74% combined. Searing Pain 1.95M (7%). Screenshot from user; exact numeric SavedVariables not provided.

739.8K last-fight boss damage / 27.0K DPS. Dread Lord 254.7K (34%), Felhunter 153.9K (21%), Imp 124.6K (17%), Succubus 57.0K (8%), Doomguard 43.4K (6%): 86% combined boss contribution. Only one boss-scope snapshot; adds present.

Proc damage panel: 1.38M damage / 2.52K DPS, credited to Pendant of the Plague (~5% overall). Healing: 15.1K total / 27.8 HPS; Leech 14.9K (99%), minor Regen and Level Up. Damage-proc events may overlap overall totals; do not sum.

Original in-game Damage Done panel simultaneously showed ~13M damage and 12 named sources, unlike Research Meter 28.86M whole-run total. Their reset windows or accounting differ; do not merge rows across panels. Soulfire had no visible damage entry, while Immolate did; this does not prove Soulfire weak because selection and proc activation are unconfirmed.

Uploaded recorder ZIP is v1.5; has 0 captured card choices and only 2 meter images with no legible damage values. Recorder log stops identifying the game as foreground after about a minute. Screenshot provides the run numbers; there is no usable item-choice/DPS causality trace in this export.

Earlier separate partial run: Warlock Demonology · Pact of the Nathrezim · user screenshot at ~9:05. Research Meter v1.3 cumulative overall damage; not directly comparable to the smaller built-in Damage Done panel. Overall top sources: Dread Lord 7.55M (26%); Imp 7.16M (25%); Felhunter 5.28M (18%); Searing Pain 1.95M (7%); Succubus 1.56M (5%). Boss: Research Meter last-fight boss panel at 9:05: 739.8K cumulative boss damage / 27.0K DPS. Top: Dread Lord 254.7K (34%); Felhunter 153.9K (21%); Imp 124.6K (17%); Succubus 57.0K (8%); Doomguard 43.4K (6%). Do not directly compare uncapped cumulative total or reconstruct DPS gains across these runs.

Run Recorder v1.6 ZIP captured 39 offered choice screens, 30 high-confidence selected-card events, 9 unresolved choice screens, and 172 meter screenshots (14m43s wall-clock elapsed). Last readable Research Meter is at ~6:04 in-game time: 7.35M overall damage and ~20.2K average DPS. In-game elapsed time differs from recorder wall time because of pause/menu time.

Felhunter 2.29M (31%), Dread Lord 1.13M (15%), Infernal 992.5K (13%), Imp 887K (12%), Succubus 540K (7%), Doomguard 282.2K (4%): about 83% combined. This is observational support for summon-heavy scaling, not proof the capstone, upgrade order, or amulet is BIS.

Soulfire dealt 473.2K (~6%) in the latest snapshot and appears in multiple selected rank-upgrade cards. Corruption 349.3K (~5%), Searing Pain 178.1K (~2%), Shadow Bolt 129.0K (~2%), Drain Life 94.7K (~1%). Searing Pain direct damage alone does not include possible Dread Lord upgrade inheritance.

Legionlord's Medallion chosen at 01:27:08; upgraded to Rank 2 at 01:31:15 (+120% duration, -42% cooldown, +120% buff strength listed on the offered upgrade). Eye of Hakkar selected at 01:35:32, replacing Legionlord. Thus the last portion has mixed amulet conditions; it is not a controlled comparison of Legionlord vs Hakkar.

Last-fight boss panel showed 295.9K damage / 9.76K DPS: Felhunter 94.2K (32%), Succubus 63.3K (21%), Dread Lord 40.0K (14%), Imp 34.6K (12%), Infernal 20.0K (7%), Soulfire ~14.5K (~5%). Healing panel 7.27K total / 20 HPS, most credited to Leech; this does not independently measure Drain Life sustain.
